classify_rules.hint: Ask→INTENT: restate verified intent + done-when in chat before CODE; write Session with Goal/Done-when/Residual + LAYER CHECK (prompt|context|harness|loop|graph). Never rewrite the user prompt. COMPLETE CAPTURE.
Ask→decision: vault_append wiki/projects/<slug>/Decisions.md + [[wikilinks]]; do not bury in chat.

Ask→memory: search_simple then targeted vault_read; write-back COMPLETE for ALL durable pages (Sessions/Decisions/Learnings/sources/concepts/journals — not vibe summaries). Cursor does not open X — vault body is memory. instructions/PROCESSING COMPLETE CAPTURE.
Ask→code: INTENT restated first; recall (obsidian_recall); shortest diff; TOOLCHAIN before Done; Session LAYER CHECK.
Ask→graph: 0xJeyx 6 steps; Cursor+skills+vault; no Neo4j/CrewAI theater. docs/LAYER-STACK.md.
Ask→process: fix rulebook/judge (harness-retro); isolate broken layer; not hand-patch output.

playbook: CURATOR (Cursor): hot seed already injected — drill via user-obsidian only pages that change next action. INTENT: restate ask + done-when before CODE (never rewrite user prompt). Follow classify/pointer hints. CODE write needs vault_read hot|index first. Durable fact → COMPLETE vault_append (sessions/decisions/learnings/sources/concepts — not stubs) + refresh hot. Before Done: Session LAYER CHECK (prompt|context|harness|loop|graph) with evidence. Debug by layer unit. Multi-agent: nodes→edges→shared disk state→eval-pass→isolate→existing orch. Law: docs/LAYER-STACK.md + docs/CURSOR-CURATOR.md + skill obsidian-memory + instructions/PROCESSING COMPLETE CAPTURE.
